abstraction_design.rationale: The components and data helpers map well onto the app's real variation and stretch to new cases (the augment seam, reusable card grid). The missing abstraction is the type pill: its markup and token convention are copied six times, so an Items section would copy it a seventh.

findings.issue: The type-pill markup (`class="pill" style:--pill-bg="var(--type-{name}, var(--color-border))"`) plus its token-naming contract with tokens.css is duplicated in six files (PokemonCard, MoveTable, pokemon/moves/types pages, types list).
findings.suggestion: Extract a `TypePill.svelte` component taking `{ name, label }` and rendering the link; all six sites collapse to one definition.

findings.issue: Card-object assembly (id/name/label/sprite/types shape) is built inline here and separately in speciesFromPokemonRefs (app/src/lib/server/data.js:50-70), so changes to card shape or default ordering land in two places.
findings.suggestion: Move card construction into a shared helper in lib/server/data.js that the home load also uses, keeping spriteFor as the single seam.

findings.issue: The augment callback reaches back into the caller's array by positional index (`entries[index].is_hidden`), a fragile contract with speciesFromPokemonRefs (app/src/lib/server/data.js:66).
findings.suggestion: Have speciesFromPokemonRefs pass the original ref entry (not just index) to augment, or accept a Map keyed by ref url.

findings.issue: No `imports` field, so deep routes use relative chains like `../../../lib/server/api.js` (app/src/routes/moves/[name]/+page.server.js:2) instead of SvelteKit 3's `#lib` subpath-import alias; moving any lib file breaks five route files.
findings.suggestion: Add `"imports": { "#lib/*": "./src/lib/*" }` to package.json and import via `#lib/server/api.js`.

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is read from process.env directly rather than through SvelteKit's environment module ($app/env/private in Kit 3), coupling the data layer to the Node adapter.
findings.suggestion: Import the base URL from `$app/env/private` (or inject it) so the client works with any adapter.

findings.issue: A single missing Pokémon record escalates to `error(500)` for the whole home page, instead of degrading to one absent card.
findings.suggestion: Skip the card (or fall back to the constructed sprite URL) rather than failing the entire list.

findings.issue: Row key is built by string concatenation (`row.method + row.move + row.level`), which can collide for odd names and breaks keyed reconciliation.
findings.suggestion: Use the loop index in the key, or a stable id assigned in the load function.

summary: This is a well-seamed SvelteKit 3 codebase: current idioms (vite.config adapter, $app/state, goto's new options), an airtight server/client split, and data logic centralized in two small modules so the sprite bug and a data-source change each land in one place. The main frictions are the six-fold duplication of the type-pill markup/token convention and the two-site card assembly, which make the removal and reordering scenarios touch more files than they should. Overall it changes comfortably, with a TypePill component and a shared card builder being the two obvious improvements.
